mapper.select: SELECT count(MSG_MST_NO) AS cnt FROM ${msg_table} WHERE MSG_STTS_CD = '00' AND SNDNG_TYPE_CD = '${msg_type}'
mapper.update: UPDATE ${msg_table} SET MSG_STTS_CD = '01', MDFCN_DT = SYSTIMESTAMP, MDFR_ID = #{mod_id} WHERE MSG_STTS_CD = '00' AND SNDNG_TYPE_CD = '${msg_type}' AND ROWNUM <= 500
mapper.select: SELECT MSG_MST_NO AS MSGID, 'AT' AS MSGTYPE, MSG_CN AS MSG, CASE WHEN SUBSTR(TRIM(RCVR_TELNO), 1, 4) IN ('0010','0070') THEN SUBSTR(TRIM(RCVR_TELNO), 2) WHEN SUBSTR(TRIM(RCVR_TELNO), 1, 4) IN ('0011','0019','0016','0017','0018') THEN SUBSTR(TRIM(RCVR_TELNO), 2, 3) || DECODE(SUBSTR(TRIM(RCVR_TELNO), 5, 1), '0', SUBSTR(TRIM(RCVR_TELNO), 6), SUBSTR(TRIM(RCVR_TELNO), 5)) WHEN SUBSTR(TRIM(RCVR_TELNO), 1, 3) IN ('011','019','016','017','018') THEN SUBSTR(TRIM(RCVR_TELNO), 1, 3) || DECODE(SUBSTR(TRIM(RCVR_TELNO), 4, 1), '0', SUBSTR(TRIM(RCVR_TELNO), 5), SUBSTR(TRIM(RCVR_TELNO), 4)) ELSE TRIM(RCVR_TELNO) END AS PHN, NVL(TRIM(SNDPTY_TELNO),'1355') AS SENDER, MOBL_BROF_CD AS PINVOICE, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS REGDT, MSG_TMPLT_CD AS TMPLID, CASE WHEN GDBK_TRSM_MTHD_CD = '01' THEN '00000000000000' WHEN GDBK_TRSM_MTHD_CD = '02' THEN SNDNG_PRNMNT_YMD || GDBK_SNDNG_PRNMNT_TM ELSE '00000000000000' END AS RESERVEDT, CASE WHEN MOBL_SYS_CD = '4INSURE' THEN '${insure_profile_key}' WHEN MOBL_SYS_CD = 'FIBP' THEN '${fibp_profile_key}' ELSE '${nps_profile_key}' END AS PROFILEKEY, SPAM_YN AS ADFLAG, BTN_NM AS BTN_TYPE, BTN_KIND_NM AS BTN_NAME, URL_MOBL_ANDR_CN AS BTN_PC, URL_PC_IOS_CN as BTN_MO, (SELECT MOBL_SYS_CD FROM MSB_LINK_SYS_E b WHERE b.MOBL_SYS_CD = a.MOBL_SYS_CD) AS SYSCD, CASE WHEN TO_DATE(SNDNG_PRNMNT_YMD, 'YYYYMMDD') < TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN '0' ELSE '1' END AS DATEFLAG FROM ${msg_table} a WHERE SNDNG_TYPE_CD = '${msg_type}' AND MSG_STTS_CD = '01'
mapper.update: update ${msg_table} set MSG_STTS_CD = '02', ISND_PRCS_DT = SYSTIMESTAMP, MDFCN_DT = SYSTIMESTAMP, MDFR_ID = #{mod_id} where MSG_STTS_CD = '01' and SNDNG_TYPE_CD = '${msg_type}'
